Package game.windows

Class IntroducingWindow

java.lang.Object
game.windows.BasicWindow
game.windows.IntroducingWindow
public class IntroducingWindow extends BasicWindow
This class represents the introducing window of the game, which is the first window that appears when the game is launched. It has options to start a new game, load a saved game, or quit the application.
Author:
Maksym Kulynych
